meta.name: frontend
meta.description: MUST USE for frontend/web UI/UX/visual work: building, styling, redesigning pages/components, React setup, performance audits, visual QA, taste, and polish. Routes four rulesets: design taste router and brand references; perfection for Playwright/Chromium Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals; ui-ux-db palettes/fonts/guidelines; designpowers personas/accessibility/critique/handoff; plus curl-only lazyweb real-app-screen research for design direction. Triggers: frontend, UI, UX, design, redesign, styling, layout, animation, motion, premium, luxury, minimal, brutalist, Awwwards, DESIGN.md, mockup, React, Lighthouse, accessibility, WCAG, Core Web Vitals, looks generic, make it pretty, like X brand, lazyweb, design research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 构建、优化和美化前端界面与交互
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要开发或改进网页的用户界面和体验
copy.tagline_en: Build, optimize, and polish frontend UI and interactions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to develop or improve web user interfaces and experiences

howto.what: Claude 会先加载设计规则集，然后根据你的要求构建或修改前端界面。它会创建一份 DESIGN.md 文件作为设计合同，并确保代码在视觉和性能上都达到专业水准。
howto.when: 当你提到前端、UI、UX、设计、重新设计、样式、布局、动画、React、Lighthouse、可访问性等关键词，或要求“让它好看”、“像某品牌”时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个类似 Stripe 的着陆页。
say.note: Claude 会加载 Stripe 的设计系统并生成页面。

say.text: 检查这个页面的 Lighthouse 性能。
say.note: Claude 会运行 Playwright 审计并给出报告。

say.text: 给这个组件添加动画效果。
say.note: Claude 会参考设计规则集添加合适的动画。

howto.what_en: Claude loads design rulesets, then builds or modifies frontend UI per your request. It creates a DESIGN.md contract and ensures code meets professional visual and performance standards.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention frontend, UI, UX, design, redesign, styling, layout, animation, React, Lighthouse, accessibility, or say 'make it pretty', 'like X brand'.

say_en.text: Design a landing page like Stripe.
say_en.note: Claude loads Stripe's design system and generates the page.

say_en.text: Run a Lighthouse audit on this page.
say_en.note: Claude runs Playwright audit and reports.
Claude adds animation per design rules.
